heading: Hi, I'm Madison
bio:
Welcome to BlackBerry Luxury Grooming! I'm so happy you're here!

I've been grooming dogs for over 3 years, and working with animals has always been one of my biggest passions. I truly love what I do, and I take so much pride in helping every dog feel and look their very best!

I started BlackBerry Luxury Grooming because I wanted to create a more personal, comfortable grooming experience where dogs receive the love, patience, and attention they deserve. 

Unlike busy grooming salons, I work with dogs one on one in a calm, cage free environment. I believe grooming should be a positive experience, not something a dog should be afraid of. 

Whether your dog is coming in for a simple nail trim, ear cleaning, bath, or a full luxury groom, I'll treat them with the same love and care I give my own dogs. 

I can't wait to meet you and your furry family member! 🐾
